name: tymphany_hpd_40n16pet00_32
title: Tymphany HPD-40N16PET00-32: 40 mm headphone driver, plastic (PET) diaphragm, NdFeB motor, 32 ohm

provenance.source: Tymphany HK Ltd, Driver Specification Sheet, Model HPD-40N16PET00-32, Rev 1, last update 2018-07-11 19:57:16 (cited as a reference driver in spec Section 5, p. 16, and the references, p. 69)
provenance.licence: Public manufacturer datasheet. Only its numeric parameters are recorded here, as facts with attribution; the document is not redistributed.
provenance.condition: Not stated on the sheet. Treated as a small-signal free-air measurement, so Mms, Cms and Rms include the free-air load.

plotted.source: Peerless by Tymphany, Driver Specification Sheet, Model HPD-40N16PET00-32, Rev 1, last update 2016-12-09 01:00:59, chart 'Frequency and Impedance Response' (the 2018 sheet's chart is empty)
plotted.method: Digitised from the chart image with tools/driver/digitize_hpd40_2016.py, calibrated on the chart's gridlines: about +/- 0.4 % in frequency, +/- 0.5 ohm and +/- 0.1 dB. The digitised curves stay in private/.

impedance.condition: free air (not stated on the sheet)

spl.condition: on axis, 'SPL (dB) @ 2.83V/1m', half space as the sheet labels its sensitivity; tolerance +/- 1.0 dB as the sheet states for its sensitivity

notes: Values are exactly as printed on the sheet, including the Cms unit (um/N). Only mm/N is consistent with fs, Mms and Vas (spec p. 16, erratum E5); the governance report flags it.
Bl, Re, Mms and fs give Qes = 0.864 and Qts = 0.655, not the printed 1.01 and 0.74 (erratum E5). The engine uses the primary set, which derives Bl = 2.24 T m, Cms = 12.6 mm/N and Rms = 0.0569 N s/m.
Rated impedance 32 ohm is the nominal value from the product description ('32 ohm'); the sheet has no separate rated-impedance field.
Rated power is the sheet's 'Rated Noise Power' of 0.01 W over a 20 Hz-20 kHz test spectrum.
The 2.83 V and 1 W sensitivities differ by 6.22 dB, which is 1 W into 33.5 ohm (the listed Zmin), not into Re or into the 32 ohm nominal.

Printed but not used: EBP (given as the formula fs/Qes), Fs/Qts 110.99 Hz, motor efficiency factor 0.2 (T m)^2/ohm, effective cone diameter 3.56 cm, voice-coil inner diameter 16.36 mm, gap height 1 mm, driver mass 0.01 kg, test spectrum 20 Hz-20 kHz.

The earlier revision of the sheet ('plotted', 2016-12-09) prints the same Thiele-Small values and differs in four fields: Zmin 32.9 ohm (2018: 33.53), half-space sensitivity 83.5 dB at 2.83 V/1 m and 89.6 dB at 1 W/1 m (2018: 74.18 and 80.4), and rated noise power 10 W (2018: 0.01 W, the value this record uses). Only the 2016 revision fills the 'Frequency and Impedance Response' chart.

The 2016 chart contradicts the primary set (governance 'plotted_*', erratum E5): the free-air impedance peaks at about 66 ohm near 109 Hz, where the primary set gives 121 ohm at 81.8 Hz, and the plotted on-axis SPL is about 6.7 dB above what the primary set gives in half space from 300 Hz to 1 kHz. The 2016 printed sensitivities match the chart; the 2018 ones are 1.2-2.3 dB below what the printed Thiele-Small values imply (74.18 dB against 75.4-76.5 dB at 2.83 V, depending on whether Vas, the printed Bl or the primary set is used).
This record keeps the printed primary set, which the spec names as its reference (p. 16). Record tymphany_hpd_40n16pet00_32_curves_2016 holds a set fitted to the 2016 curves.
